ruling.recommended_action: Uphold the $6.61 no-show cancellation fee; reply to the rider citing the GPS-verified 3:05 wait at the pickup point. No account action needed.

rejected_claims.reason: Rider claims she came out about a minute after cancellation, implying the driver left too early. GPS shows the driver stationary within ~40 m of the pickup point from 09:56:30 to 09:59:25 (3:05), so the 3-minute wait in NS-1(iii) was completed before the 09:59:25 cancellation.
